title: First exterior sheaf is the original sheaf
statement: For every scheme X and sheaf of modules M on X, the sheafified sectionwise exterior power exteriorSheaf M 1 [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power] is isomorphic to M.

proof.text: On each open U use Mathlib exteriorPower.oneEquiv, sending a singleton wedge to its entry. The defining characterization of exteriorSheafRestriction [def-sc-sheaf-exterior-power] implies compatibility on singleton wedges, which span, hence on every section. These equivalences give a presheaf isomorphism. Sheafify it and compose with the invertible counit of PresheafOfModules.sheafificationAdjunction at the already-sheaf M.
